name: tower-builder-one
features: Build mode places beams of steel, wood or reinforced concrete between grid nodes within the budget.
Delete removes beams, and pan and zoom move the view.
Test runs a wind test then an earthquake against the target height.
Budget, spent, target height, score and level show, and clear resets.
overlap: Same game as tower-builder-five, plus an info panel. Likely merge host.
